page.overview:
Who is Julien Davinos?

Sir is a human fighter/rogue played by Matthew Mercer in Campaign Four.

Sir Julien is a man with a lanky, compact build and long curling black hair. Although it is not visible at first glance, one of the teeth in his mouth is missing a piece, chipped during a melee. He wears the reinforced leather military uniform of House Davinos: dark purples and gray with red trim. Covering his left shoulder is a dark green short cape with a detailed motif of vine and flowers sewn into it. His armor includes two prominent items of intricate silver: a pauldron on his right shoulder and on his left hand a full gauntlet of dark silver that is heavy enough to make him seem unbalanced. He carries a rapier. After he started traveling with the Seekers he made sure to hide any symbols of his family in his clothes, to avoid unwanted attention.

His shadow looks darker and deeper than normal, a sign of him being cursed.

Julien seems to care deeply about honor, mentioning several times it as a point of dislike towards Thjazi Fang, someone he felt had little honor in his life. Julien indulges frequently in worldly delights such as local taverns and brothels.
